why: Asinine Antics makes Cursed Role tokens, Auras you control.
Each Role entering is an enchantment entering, which Doomwake Giant's constellation watches.
Fat Chocobo makes the Bird token that carries the landfall trigger.
Fenrir's chapter I puts a land onto the battlefield, feeding the Bird's landfall (owner: tokens stay nodes).
Nalia lets you cast Rogues from the top of your library; each is a spell sharing the commander's type, which Folk Hero's granted draw watches.
